theorems.name: Submission.rpn_pe_convolution_contDiff_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K a : Eucl n → ℝ), LocallyIntegrable K → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y => ∫ t, K t * a (y - t)) ∧ ∀ y v : Eucl n, Integrable (fun t => K t * fderiv ℝ a (y - t) v) ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∫ t, K t * a (y - t)) y v = ∫ t, K t * fderiv ℝ a (y - t) v
